blocks.text: TORONTO– Jalen Brunson converted a tiebreaking four-point play with 1:25 left in the fourth quarter, Karl-Anthony Towns had 16 points and 16 rebounds and the New York Knicks beat Toronto 111-102 on Tuesday night, their 15th consecutive win over the Raptors. Brunson scored 31 points. He shot 10 for 22, made 4 of 11 from 3-point range and went 7 for 7 at the free throw line.
